udt_struct_v0.doc:
The anchored mirror for one (asset, cause): `anchored`
is the cumulative event-rebuilt total, `settled` the
cumulative paid out by settlements, `last_anchor_ledger`
the ledger the latest anchor read through.
udt_struct_v0.name: Book

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A cause entry, stored in the contract and readable by
anyone by simulation. `performer_bps` is fixed at
registration and immutable for this ID \xe2\x80\x94 a cause that
wants new terms registers a new ID, so every settlement
for an ID is graded against the one number its entry has
always carried.
udt_struct_v0.name: Cause

function_v0.doc:
Post the anchored mirror for one (asset, cause): the
cumulative credited total rebuilt from the event
stream through `through_ledger`, with the digest of
the event batch it was rebuilt from. Monotonic, as
the shelf's: lowering the total or moving the ledger
backwards refuses. Anchoring to an unregistered
cause refuses.
function_v0.name: anchor

function_v0.doc:
Execute the split for everything anchored and not
yet settled, under the cause entry's stored rule.
Permissionless: anyone may call it and the caller
gains nothing by calling. Returns (total settled,
performer amount, cause amount); a call with nothing
unsettled returns zeros and moves nothing. The
settlement event carries every amount and the bps it
was graded under, so the split is as public as the
tips themselves.
function_v0.name: settle

function_v0.doc:
Register a cause: one posting, one ID, its split
rule stored in the same write and immutable from
that moment. IDs are sequential from 1; ID 0 is
never a cause, so a credit carrying ID 0 or any
unregistered ID is unattributed by definition.
function_v0.name: register_cause
